government_registration.authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India

hardware_specifications.compiler: Native Compiled Rust 1.80+ (Link-Time Optimized, Zero Interpreters)
hardware_specifications.external_dependencies: None (Zero Python, Zero Node.js, Zero Electron, Zero JVM)

catalog.name: RQL DocumentShield
catalog.description: Enterprise forensic PDF redaction, true permanent vector sanitization, automated SSN/Tax EIN pattern purger, and court-admissible SHA-256 compliance certification.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Sanitizes a 500-page court exhibit in 1.4 seconds in 13.8 MB RAM vs Adobe Acrobat 210 MB RAM / 18.2 seconds.

catalog.name: RQL WhisperVault
catalog.description: Air-gapped local AI speech-to-text intelligence powered by offline Whisper neural models with millisecond word-level SRT/VTT generation and executive PDF meeting summaries.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Transcribes 1 hour audio in 42s (GPU) / 1m 58s (8-core CPU) using local INT8 quantized neural model with zero cloud telemetry.

catalog.name: RQL RetailPOS
catalog.description: Sub-millisecond barcode checkout, split-payment tender, ESC/POS 80mm thermal receipt generation, and double-entry SQLite WAL ledger for supermarkets.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Sub-millisecond (0.18ms) scan-to-cart latency, handles 50,000 SKUs with zero lag during total internet and cloud outages.

catalog.name: RQL StoreChain
catalog.description: Multi-branch retail inventory replication, cryptographic transfer manifests, and peer-to-peer ledger sync without cloud databases.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Peer-to-peer differential sync of 10,000 transactions across 5 registers in 320ms over local in-store Wi-Fi without internet.

catalog.name: RQL Conduit
catalog.description: Multi-WAN channel bonding, automatic failover engine, zero-cloud VPN, and sub-1ms network link aggregation for mission-critical trading and billing desks.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Bonds 3 WAN links simultaneously with 0.8ms packet failover, maintaining 100% TCP session continuity during physical wire cut.

catalog.name: RQL HashCheck
catalog.description: High-speed cryptographic integrity auditing (SHA-256, SHA-512, MD5, BLAKE3) with recursive directory tree verification and tampered file alerting.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Processes a 10 GB file in 3.1s using multi-threaded SIMD BLAKE3 / SHA-256 at 3.2 GB/s NVMe line rate.

catalog.name: RQL QRStudio
catalog.description: Offline forensic QR and 2D barcode generator supporting vector SVG/PNG export, batch dynamic payload encoding, and air-gapped retail labels.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Renders 5,000 vector SVG QR codes in 1.1s with ECC level H error correction and custom micro-branding.

catalog.name: RQL TextDiff
catalog.description: High-speed line, word, and character-level difference visualizer with unified patch generator, syntax highlighting, and zero network calls.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Diffs two 100,000-line codebases or legal contracts in 0.4s with character-level Myers diff algorithm.

catalog.name: RQL Renamer
catalog.description: Bulk file and folder renaming engine with regex substitution, EXIF metadata extraction, sequential padding, and instant dry-run preview.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Batch renames 25,000 photo and document files in 0.6s with instant atomic undo journal.

catalog.name: RQL TagEditor
catalog.description: Offline audio metadata editor for MP3, FLAC, OGG, and M4A. Batch tag injection, album art embedding, and ID3v2.4 compliance.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Updates ID3v2.4 tags and embeds hi-res album art across 2,000 lossless FLAC tracks in 1.8s.

catalog.name: RQL FontViewer
catalog.description: High-performance typography and glyph visualizer for TTF, OTF, and WOFF2 formats with custom sample text rendering and Unicode table mapping.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Parses 1,200 font files with 65,536 glyph Unicode maps in 0.9s with zero GDI memory leaks.

catalog.name: RQL DPDPShield
catalog.description: India Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 compliance sentry. Scans institutional data lakes for PII, Aadhaar, and PAN numbers.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Audits a 50 GB database dump for 14 Indian PII patterns in 18.4s, generating Ed25519-signed compliance audit logs.

catalog.name: RQL PriceTag
catalog.description: Supermarket retail shelf price tag generator with automated EAN-13 barcodes, discount tags, and multi-label printable sheets.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Generates 500 A4 printable supermarket shelf labels (38-up format) with barcode verification in 0.7s.

catalog.name: RQL InvoiceGen
catalog.description: GST-compliant invoice generation engine with dynamic B2B QR codes, split tax tables, and tamper-evident PDF output.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Batches 1,000 compliant GST invoices with dynamic UPI payment QR codes in 1.9s in 13.5 MB RAM.

catalog.name: RQL CSVFormat
catalog.description: Multi-gigabyte CSV parsing and re-encoding tool operating at native disk read speed with zero memory leaks.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Normalizes a 20-million-row CSV (4.8 GB) with encoding repair and delimiter transformation in 6.2s.

catalog.name: RQL PDFMerge
catalog.description: Lossless PDF combining, page extraction, rotation, and blank page elimination engine with zero quality compression loss.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Merges 100 high-resolution PDF case briefs (2,400 pages) into a single optimized document in 1.1s.

catalog.name: RQL TaxLedger
catalog.description: Offline 20-feature accounting workstation with GSTR-1 portal JSON export, Section 44ADA engine, and MCA audit trail durability.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Calculates balance sheet, P&L, and generates official GSTR-1 JSON across 50,000 ledger entries in 0.8s.

catalog.name: RQL FileShredder
catalog.description: Overwrites sensitive files using multi-pass DoD 5220.22-M sector wiping so deleted data can never be forensically recovered.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Destroys a 1 GB confidential folder using 7-pass DoD overwrite in 2.4s, zero recovery by Ontrack/Recuva.

catalog.name: RQL ClipVault
catalog.description: ChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted local clipboard history vault with instant fuzzy search, secret masking, and zero cloud sync.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Retrieves any clipping from 500,000 stored entries in < 2ms with zero disk paging in 5.6 MB RAM.

catalog.name: RQL ImageBatch
catalog.description: SIMD-accelerated batch image processor. WebP/JPEG/PNG conversion, lossless metadata stripping, and aspect preservation.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Compresses and watermarks 1,000 4K e-commerce product photos to WebP in 4.8s (80% size reduction).

catalog.name: RQL AudioExtract
catalog.description: Lossless audio demuxer extracting pristine WAV, FLAC, and AAC tracks from MP4, MKV, and AVI containers without re-encoding.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Demuxes 2-hour 4K video audio track in 1.8s at disk bus transfer speed with zero loss.

catalog.name: RQL SubtitleSync
catalog.description: Visual audio waveform subtitle re-aligner for SRT, VTT, and ASS tracks with linear timecode stretching.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Re-aligns 1,800 dialogue subtitle cues with audio speech envelope in 0.5s.

catalog.name: RQL SpaceMap
catalog.description: High-speed disk treemap visualizer analyzing millions of file allocations in seconds with direct cluster waste analysis.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Scans a 2 TB NVMe drive containing 1,500,000 files in 4.2s with zero background CPU thrashing.

catalog.name: RQL DocProtect
catalog.description: AES-256 PDF access protector with granular permission flags (printing restriction, content extraction lock).
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Applies 256-bit AES encryption with print-locking to 500 contract briefs in 1.3s.

catalog.name: RQL CashDrawer
catalog.description: Hardware interface triggering ESC/POS RJ11/RJ12 drawer kick pulses via USB, Serial COM, and virtual print spools.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Fires mechanical cash drawer solenoid in 12ms with double-entry manual audit event logging.

catalog.name: RQL ReceiptPrinter
catalog.description: Raw ESC/POS thermal receipt formatting engine with graphic raster logo injection and paper cut sequencing.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Spools and formats 80mm thermal receipts with raster logo in 18ms with 100% printer driver independence.

catalog.name: RQL ClauseForge
catalog.description: Offline legal contract and NDA drafting workstation with pre-compiled jurisdictional boilerplate clauses.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Assembles custom 40-clause cross-border M&A NDA in 0.3s with zero cloud telemetry.

catalog.name: RQL ArchiveMaster
catalog.description: Multi-core 7z, TAR, and ZIP compression engine with ChaCha20-Poly1305 header encryption.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Compresses 10 GB mixed assets into encrypted 7z container in 28s using multi-core SIMD threading.

catalog.name: RQL SocketShield
catalog.description: Air-gap telemetry trapper intercepting and nullifying unauthorized background outbound Winsock API calls at the NDIS boundary.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Traps 100% of outbound socket attempts from 50 running processes with sub-microsecond kernel filtering overhead.

catalog.name: RQL PingPulse
catalog.description: Sub-millisecond ICMP and TCP jitter monitor with historical latency charting and audio drop alarms.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Measures ping jitter with 10-microsecond resolution across 20 exchange endpoints simultaneously.

catalog.name: RQL FolderSync
catalog.description: High-speed folder synchronization engine with CRC32/SHA-256 delta verification and bidirectional mirroring.
catalog.empirical_benchmark: Synchronizes 100,000 files across two local arrays in 1.4s using block-level differential hashing.
